The '''1984–85 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 49th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 23 September 1984 and ended on 16 June 1985. [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] won their second Greek title and their first one in nine years.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
